control.title: Multi-factor authentication for administrators
control.description: Mock control, not authoritative. Privileged human access should require more than one authentication factor.
evaluation_criteria: All interactive privileged accounts require MFA.
Any emergency account exception is limited, documented, and monitored.
The active identity configuration agrees with the policy.
expected_evidence: Identity-provider MFA configuration or coverage export

repetitions.justification: Les preuves fournies ne montrent pas que tous les comptes d'administrateurs interactifs nécessitent l'authentification multifactorielle (MFA). Les documents ne contiennent pas de preuves concrètes que l'authentification MFA est activée pour tous les comptes d'administrateurs interactifs. De plus, il n'y a aucune mention d'exceptions d'urgence limitées, documentées et surveillées.

quotes.text: All interactive privileged users must complete a password and a hardware or app-based second factor. A monitored emergency identity is excluded and reviewed monthly.

repetitions.recommendation: Implement MFA for all interactive privileged accounts and ensure that any emergency account exceptions are limited, documented, and monitored.
